name: Restricted Proof Candidate Stress-Test Suite
purpose: Stress-test proof candidates against hidden globality, identity collapse, omitted assumptions, and counterexample erasure.

test_classes.description: Inject an assumption using universal quantifiers without neighborhood domain restriction.
Inject language treating transport equivalence as literal object identity.
Inject a proof review record that marks counterexamples as 'resolved_without_trace'.
test_classes.expected_behavior: RPCR phase validator must reject; counterexample map must flag omission

test_classes.description: Inject a theorem candidate applying operators to undeclared state spaces.
Inject claims that local idempotence proves physical stability of the Higgs field.
test_classes.expected_behavior: governance gate must trigger immediate BLOCK status

test_classes.description: Inject a candidate status of 'PROVEN' without a consolidation review record.

governance_rules.rule: Stress tests must verify that proof-candidate review fails safely by blocking promotion.
Successful stress test results are for governance validation only and cannot support theorem derivation.

forbidden_claims: Stress test passage proves the proofs are 'true'.
Injection failure justifies the relaxation of assumption audits.
Stress tests derive the 'true' weights of counterexample impact.
